metadata.name: trust_protocol
metadata.description: Decentralized trust infrastructure for autonomous AI agents

instructions.name: accept_contract
docs: Requester accepts deliverable. Releases payment + returns stake.

accounts.name: provider_token_account
docs: For SWORN: provider's ATA. For SOL: provider's wallet (system account).

accounts.name: treasury_token_account
docs: For SWORN: admin's ATA. For SOL: admin's wallet (system account).

accounts.name: insurance_vault
docs: For SWORN: insurance vault ATA. For SOL: pool authority PDA.

accounts.name: escrow_vault
docs: Escrow vault PDA for SWORN contracts. Unused for SOL.

accounts.name: sworn_mint
docs: SWORN mint for the burn CPI (10% of fee). Unused for SOL contracts.

accounts.name: requester_token_account
docs: Requester's token account for SWORN top-up (§7.7).

instructions.name: accept_correction
docs: Requester accepts provider's correction during dispute.
Resolves dispute + completes contract (releases payment).

accounts.name: requester_identity
docs: Requester identity for dispute friction penalty (§9.3).

accounts.name: provider_token_account
docs: For SWORN: provider's ATA. For SOL: provider's wallet.

accounts.name: treasury_token_account
docs: For SWORN: admin's ATA. For SOL: admin's wallet.

accounts.name: insurance_vault
docs: For SWORN: insurance vault ATA. For SOL: pool authority PDA.

accounts.name: escrow_vault
docs: Escrow vault PDA for SWORN contracts. Unused for SOL.

accounts.name: sworn_mint
docs: SWORN mint for the burn CPI (10% of fee). Unused for SOL contracts.

accounts.name: requester_token_account
docs: Requester's token account for SWORN top-up (§7.7).

instructions.name: accept_proposal
docs: Provider accepts a proposed contract by depositing stake.
Transitions contract from Proposed to Active.

accounts.name: provider_identity
docs: Provider's identity — validates ban status, enforces exposure limit, tracks active_contracts

accounts.name: provider_token_account
docs: Provider's SWORN token account (only needed for SWORN-denominated contracts)

accounts.name: escrow_vault
docs: Escrow vault - already initialized by propose_contract (SWORN contracts only)

instructions.name: approve_insurance_claim
docs: Approve insurance claim (admin Phase 0-2, DAO Phase 3+).

instructions.name: calculate_trust_score
docs: Compute and store TrustScore on-chain using the whitepaper formula.
Permissionless: any caller triggers recalculation.
sol_to_sworn_rate: SOL lamport to SWORN lamport exchange rate for volume normalization.

instructions.name: cancel_proposal
docs: Cancel an expired proposal. Requester reclaims escrowed funds.

accounts.name: escrow_vault
docs: Escrow vault - return funds to requester

instructions.name: check_maturation
docs: Permissionless maturation check: marks identity as matured if 14 days + 5 tasks.
Whitepaper Section 10.2: agents self-mature without oracle dependency.

instructions.name: create_contract
docs: Create contract. Provider stakes based on TrustScore.
stake = value * factor_stake(score). Score 0 = 100%, Score 100 = 5%.
currency: 0=SWORN (default), 1=SOL. Whitepaper §11.8b.

accounts.name: escrow_vault
docs: Escrow vault PDA for this contract (initialized at contract creation)

accounts.name: sworn_mint
docs: SWORN token mint (validated against protocol config)

instructions.name: deliver_contract
docs: Provider submits deliverable with Proof of Execution (PoE).
Whitepaper Section 1: immutable PoE with input/output hashes.

instructions.name: deny_insurance_claim
docs: Deny insurance claim. Collateral forfeited as anti-spam.

instructions.name: deposit_stake
docs: Deposit SWORN into SBLP. Split: 40% liquid reserve, 60% LP allocation.

instructions.name: deposit_to_insurance_pool
docs: Deposit tokens into the InsurancePool.
Whitepaper §11.5b: 60% of confiscations, 20% of protocol fees go to pool.

instructions.name: emit_work_reward
docs: Emit work reward for a completed task. Halving schedule: 10 SWORN base,
halves every 50,000 tasks. Converges to 1M SWORN total automatic emission.

accounts.name: work_rewards_vault
docs: Work rewards reserve vault (holds the 15M SWORN allocation)

accounts.name: provider_token_account
docs: Provider SWORN token account (receives the reward)

instructions.name: escalate_dispute
docs: Escalate dispute to next level (Level 1→2→3 only, no stake required).

accounts.name: initiator
docs: Either the requester or provider may escalate (Whitepaper Section 9).

instructions.name: escalate_to_appeal
docs: Escalate a Level 3 (PublicJury) dispute to Level 4 (Appeal).
Whitepaper Section 9.5: escalating party deposits 50% of contract value (double-or-nothing).
On win: deposit returned. On loss: deposit confiscated (60% insurance, 25% winner, 15% burn).
Records depositor in dispute.initiator for correct refund/confiscation in resolve_dispute.

accounts.name: escalator_token_account
docs: For SWORN: escalator's ATA. For SOL: pass any account (not used).

accounts.name: escrow_vault
docs: For SWORN: contract escrow vault. For SOL: pass any account (not used).

instructions.name: expire_hibernation
docs: Permissionless: expire hibernation once max duration has passed.
Resets hibernation state so standard decay resumes automatically.

instructions.name: file_insurance_claim
docs: File retroactive claim within 90-day window. Max 80% of contract value.

instructions.name: force_mature
docs: Force-mature an agent (devnet testing only).
Bypasses maturation period for testing contract lifecycle.

instructions.name: harvest_lp_fees
docs: Harvest LP fees. Distribution: 70% staker, 20% treasury, 10% insurance.

instructions.name: hibernate_agent
docs: Declare hibernation: reduced decay (0.5/month) for up to 12 months.
Must be called BEFORE going inactive. Requires 5-task cooldown between hibernations.

instructions.name: initialize
docs: Initialize the Trust Protocol with SWORN token and global config.
Whitepaper Section 8: Governance Phase 0 (founding team).

accounts.name: sworn_mint
docs: The SWORN token mint (fixed supply 100M, decimals 6 — whitepaper §11.2)

instructions.name: initiate_dispute
docs: Initiate dispute on a contract.

instructions.name: jury_vote
docs: Jury vote (Public Jury / Appeal only, TrustScore > 70 required).

accounts.name: vote_record
docs: Double-vote prevention: one VoteRecord PDA per juror per dispute.
The `init` constraint rejects any second vote from the same juror.

instructions.name: migrate_agent_identity
docs: Migrate AgentIdentity v1 (95 bytes) to v2 (123 bytes).
Inserts volume_sol, total_deliveries, corrections_received, active_contracts,
last_task_completed_at fields (all zero) at correct Borsh offsets.
Idempotent: already-migrated accounts (123 bytes) are skipped.

accounts.name: agent_identity
docs: Cannot use Account<AgentIdentity> because old accounts have 95 bytes
and would fail Anchor deserialization against the new 123-byte struct.

instructions.name: migrate_agent_v3
docs: Migrate AgentIdentity v2 (123 bytes) -> v3 (146 bytes).
Adds hibernation + dispute_friction fields. Run after migrate_config_v3.

accounts.name: protocol_config
docs: Protocol config — must be migrated to v3 first so Anchor can deserialize it.

instructions.name: migrate_bond_vault
docs: Migrate bond vault: close old (v1) vault, create new (v2) vault, update config.
Drains old tokens to admin, closes account, inits new vault with new mint.

accounts.name: old_bond_vault
docs: Old bond vault (will be closed)

accounts.name: admin_old_token_account
docs: Admin's token account for the OLD mint (receives drained tokens)

accounts.name: new_sworn_mint
docs: The new SWORN mint (v2 with metadata)

accounts.name: new_bond_vault
docs: New bond vault PDA — initialized with new mint.
Uses different seeds ("bond-vault-v2") since old PDA can't be reused in same TX.

instructions.name: migrate_config_v3
docs: Migrate ProtocolConfig v2 (146 bytes) -> v3 (186 bytes).
Adds work-reward halving fields. Must be run FIRST before other v3 migrations.

instructions.name: migrate_dispute
docs: Migrate Dispute v1 (218 bytes) -> v2 (219 bytes).
Adds private_rounds_count field. Run after migrate_config_v3.

accounts.name: protocol_config
docs: Protocol config — must be migrated to v3 first.

instructions.name: migrate_dispute_appeal_stake
docs: Migrate Dispute accounts to include appeal_stake field (u64).
Reallocs from 170 to 178 bytes. The new 8 bytes are zero-filled (appeal_stake=0).
appeal_stake is populated by escalate_to_appeal when Level 4 is reached.
Whitepaper Section 9.5: double-or-nothing stake deposit by escalating party.
Call once per old dispute. Idempotent for already-migrated accounts.

accounts.name: dispute
docs: because old accounts have smaller size and fail deserialization.

instructions.name: migrate_dispute_arbitration_fee
docs: Migrate Dispute accounts to include arbitration_fee field (u64).
Reallocs from 178 to 186 bytes. The new 8 bytes are zero-filled.
Whitepaper Section 9.4: 2% arbitration fee per party for L3/L4 disputes.

instructions.name: migrate_dispute_size
docs: Migrate old Dispute accounts to include corrections_count field.
Reallocs from 169 to 170 bytes. Call once per old dispute.

accounts.name: dispute
docs: because old accounts have smaller size and fail deserialization.

instructions.name: migrate_insurance_pool
docs: Migrate InsurancePool v1 (61 bytes) -> v2 (69 bytes).
Adds total_active_exposure field. Run after migrate_config_v3.

accounts.name: protocol_config
docs: Protocol config — must be migrated to v3 first.

instructions.name: migrate_protocol_config
docs: Migrate ProtocolConfig from v1 (133 bytes) to v2 (146 bytes).
Adds protocol_fee_sworn_bps, protocol_fee_sol_bps, max_corrections,
deadline_validation fields with whitepaper defaults.
Idempotent: already-migrated accounts (146 bytes) are skipped.

accounts.name: protocol_config
docs: Cannot use Account<ProtocolConfig> because old accounts have 133 bytes
and would fail Anchor deserialization against the new 146-byte struct.

instructions.name: place_bid
docs: Place a bid on a public contract. Computes bid_score on-chain.
bid_score = W_price * price_score + W_trust * trust_norm + W_speed * speed_score

instructions.name: propose_contract
docs: Propose a contract. Only requester signs; deposits escrow.
Provider must call accept_proposal to activate.
currency: 0=SWORN (SPL token), 1=SOL (native lamports). Whitepaper Section 11.8b.

accounts.name: provider_identity
docs: Provider's identity - read-only, used to calculate stake requirement.

accounts.name: escrow_vault
docs: Escrow vault PDA - holds requester's deposit until provider accepts or proposal expires.

instructions.name: redeliver_in_dispute
docs: Provider re-delivers corrected work during Level 1 dispute.
Max 3 corrections before auto-escalation to Level 2 (PrivateRounds).

instructions.name: register_agent
docs: Register a new agent with soulbound identity bond (2-5 SWORN).
Creates DID: did:trust:{pubkey}. 14-day maturation period (+ 5 tasks).

accounts.name: agent_token_account
docs: Agent's SWORN token account (source of bond)

accounts.name: bond_vault
docs: Bond vault (PDA-controlled, tokens locked permanently)
Uses bond-vault-v2 seeds after v1→v2 migration.

instructions.name: reject_delivery
docs: Requester rejects delivery and requests correction (Whitepaper §6.2).
corrections_used is incremented. Auto-escalates to dispute when limit reached.

instructions.name: resolve_dispute
docs: Resolve dispute. Confiscated stakes: 15% burned, 60% insurance, 25% winner.

accounts.name: provider_token_account
docs: For SWORN: provider's ATA. For SOL: provider's wallet.

accounts.name: requester_token_account
docs: For SWORN: requester's ATA. For SOL: requester's wallet.

accounts.name: escrow_vault
docs: Escrow vault PDA for SWORN. Unused for SOL.

accounts.name: insurance_vault
docs: For SWORN: insurance vault ATA. For SOL: pool authority PDA.

accounts.name: sworn_mint
docs: SWORN mint. Only used for SWORN burn path.

instructions.name: respond_dispute
docs: Provider responds to dispute with correction/counter-evidence.

instructions.name: select_bid
docs: Requester selects a winning bid and assigns the provider.

accounts.name: bidder_authority
docs: The authority wallet of the bidder (used as PDA seed)

instructions.name: setup_bond_vault
docs: Set up bond vault token account (one-time, after initialize).
Required before any agent can register.

accounts.name: sworn_mint
docs: The SWORN token mint referenced by protocol config

accounts.name: bond_vault
docs: Bond vault PDA — initialized here as a token account

instructions.name: sponsor_agent
docs: Sponsor an agent (established agent vouches for newcomer).
Sponsor must have TrustScore >= 50 and matured identity.

instructions.name: timeout_contract
docs: Permissionless timeout: resolves abandoned contract after 72h delivery deadline.
Provider's stake is confiscated (60% insurance, 25% requester bonus, 15% burn).
Requester receives full escrow + 25% stake bonus.
Whitepaper Section 3/5: failed delivery = tasks_abandoned++, active_contracts--.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless: anyone can trigger the timeout after 72h

accounts.name: requester_token_account
docs: For SWORN: requester's ATA. For SOL: requester's wallet.

accounts.name: escrow_vault
docs: Escrow vault PDA for SWORN. Unused for SOL (lamports live in contract PDA).

accounts.name: insurance_vault
docs: For SWORN: insurance vault ATA. For SOL: not used (lamports go to requester).

accounts.name: sworn_mint
docs: SWORN mint for burn CPI. Unused for SOL.

instructions.name: timeout_delivery
docs: Permissionless: auto-accept Delivered contract if requester ignores it for 72h.
Whitepaper Section 3.5: protects provider from requester ghosting. GAP-11.

accounts.name: caller
docs: Permissionless: any caller can trigger after 72h

accounts.name: requester_identity
docs: Requester identity — for reputational penalty on timeout (Whitepaper §7.5)

accounts.name: provider_token_account
docs: For SWORN: provider's ATA. For SOL: provider's wallet.

accounts.name: treasury_token_account
docs: For SWORN: admin's ATA. For SOL: admin's wallet.

accounts.name: insurance_vault
docs: For SWORN: insurance vault ATA. For SOL: unused (pass dummy).

accounts.name: escrow_vault
docs: Escrow vault PDA for SWORN contracts.

accounts.name: sworn_mint
docs: SWORN mint for burn CPI. Unused for SOL.

instructions.name: update_config
docs: Admin: update protocol config parameters (min_bond, maturation_period, etc.).
Whitepaper §8: Phase 0-2 admin-controlled. GAP-1/GAP-2 fix.

instructions.name: update_insurance_exposure
docs: Update InsurancePool total_active_exposure for solvency ratio calculation.
Whitepaper §11.5c: solvency_ratio = balance / exposure. Admin-only Phase 0-2.

instructions.name: update_sworn_mint
docs: Update SWORN mint address (v1 -> v2 migration).
Admin only (Phase 0-2 governance).

accounts.name: new_sworn_mint
docs: The new SWORN mint to set

instructions.name: wake_agent
docs: Wake from hibernation early (or can be called by anyone after expiry via expire_hibernation).

instructions.name: withdraw_bid
docs: Withdraw (cancel) a bid on a public contract.

instructions.name: withdraw_stake
docs: Withdraw SWORN from liquid reserve.

errors.name: InvalidBondAmount
errors.msg: Identity bond must be between 2 and 5 SWORN tokens

errors.name: IdentityNotMatured
errors.msg: Agent identity has not matured (14-day + 5-task requirement)

errors.name: AgentBanned
errors.msg: Agent is permanently banned due to fraud

errors.name: InsufficientStake
errors.msg: Insufficient stake for contract value and TrustScore

errors.name: InvalidContractStatus
errors.msg: Contract is not in the expected status

errors.name: UnauthorizedRequester
errors.msg: Only the contract requester can perform this action

errors.name: UnauthorizedProvider
errors.msg: Only the contract provider can perform this action

errors.name: MaxDisputeLevel
errors.msg: Dispute level cannot be escalated further

errors.name: DisputeDeadlineNotReached
errors.msg: Dispute deadline has not passed

errors.name: DisputeDeadlineExpired
errors.msg: Dispute deadline has passed

errors.name: InsufficientJuryReputation
errors.msg: Jury member TrustScore must be > 70

errors.name: ClaimWindowExpired
errors.msg: Retroactive claim window (90 days) has expired

errors.name: ClaimAmountExceeded
errors.msg: Claim amount exceeds 80% of contract value

errors.name: ExposureLimitExceeded
errors.msg: Agent exposure exceeds 3x capital limit

errors.name: UnauthorizedAdmin
errors.msg: Only protocol admin can perform this action

errors.name: PoEHashMismatch
errors.msg: Proof of Execution hash mismatch

errors.name: InsufficientCollateral
errors.msg: Insufficient collateral for insurance claim

errors.name: GovernancePhaseRestricted
errors.msg: Governance phase does not allow this action

errors.name: MathOverflow
errors.msg: Arithmetic overflow

errors.name: AlreadyVoted
errors.msg: Agent has already voted on this dispute

errors.name: SoulboundViolation
errors.msg: Identity bond is soulbound and cannot be transferred

errors.name: InvalidEscrowVault
errors.msg: Invalid escrow vault PDA

errors.name: ProposalExpired
errors.msg: Contract proposal has expired

errors.name: ProposalNotExpired
errors.msg: Proposal has not expired yet (cannot cancel before expiry)

errors.name: InvalidCurrency
errors.msg: Invalid currency value (must be 0=SWORN or 1=SOL)

errors.name: CurrencyMismatchSol
errors.msg: Currency mismatch: operation requires SOL-denominated contract

errors.name: CurrencyMismatchSworn
errors.msg: Currency mismatch: operation requires SWORN-denominated contract

errors.name: MaxCorrectionsReached
errors.msg: Maximum corrections reached (3). Dispute auto-escalated to Level 2.

errors.name: InvalidDestination
errors.msg: Destination account does not match expected recipient

errors.name: InvalidAccountSize
errors.msg: Account size is not the expected old format size

errors.name: TimeoutNotReached
errors.msg: Contract delivery timeout (72h) has not been reached yet

errors.name: JuryStillVoting
errors.msg: Jury is still voting: quorum not reached and deadline has not passed

errors.name: AgentHibernating
errors.msg: Agent is currently hibernating and cannot accept new contracts

errors.name: AgentNotHibernating
errors.msg: Agent is not currently hibernating

errors.name: AlreadyHibernating
errors.msg: Hibernation already active for this agent

errors.name: HibernationCooldown
errors.msg: Hibernation cooldown: must complete 5 tasks after last hibernation

errors.name: InvalidHibernationDuration
errors.msg: Hibernation duration must be between 1 and 12 months

errors.name: ClaimExceedsPoolCap
errors.msg: Claim exceeds 5% of InsurancePool balance (§11.5b per-claim cap)

errors.name: InsurancePoolCrisis
errors.msg: InsurancePool in crisis (solvency < 0.5): only proven fraud claims accepted (§11.5c)

errors.name: ContractNotPublic
errors.msg: Contract is not public (visibility must be 1 for bidding, §6.5)

errors.name: ContractNotBiddable
errors.msg: Contract is not in Created/Proposed status (cannot bid on active contracts)

errors.name: BidPriceTooHigh
errors.msg: Proposed price exceeds contract escrow amount

errors.name: BidStakeInsufficient
errors.msg: Bid stake offered is below the minimum required for bidder TrustScore

errors.name: BidNotActive
errors.msg: Bid not found or already withdrawn

errors.name: UnauthorizedBidder
errors.msg: Only the bid owner can withdraw this bid

errors.name: UnauthorizedBidSelector
errors.msg: Only the contract requester can select a bid

errors.name: InsufficientLiquidReserve
errors.msg: Insufficient liquid reserve for withdrawal (§11.10)

errors.name: WithdrawExceedsStake
errors.msg: Withdrawal amount exceeds staked balance

errors.name: NoFeesToHarvest
errors.msg: No LP fees to harvest

errors.name: ZeroDeposit
errors.msg: Deposit amount must be greater than zero

types.name: AgentIdentity
docs: Agent identity account - soulbound, non-transferable (Whitepaper Section 2: Identity Model)
Created on registration with a 2-5 SWORN identity bond.
DID format: did:trust:{pubkey}

fields.name: authority
docs: The agent's wallet authority

fields.name: identity_bond
docs: SWORN tokens locked as identity bond (2-5 tokens, anti-Sybil)

fields.name: registered_at
docs: Unix timestamp of registration

fields.name: matured
docs: Whether this identity has matured (14 days + 5 tasks — see check_maturation)

fields.name: trust_score
docs: Current TrustScore (0-100, computed on-chain via calculate_trust_score instruction)

fields.name: tasks_completed
docs: Total tasks completed (logarithmic weight in TrustScore)

fields.name: volume_processed
docs: Total transaction volume in SWORN lamports

fields.name: volume_sol
docs: Total transaction volume in SOL lamports (tracked separately for TrustScore)

fields.name: disputes_lost
docs: Disputes lost count

fields.name: disputes_won
docs: Disputes won count

fields.name: tasks_abandoned
docs: Tasks abandoned count

fields.name: fraud_flags
docs: Fraud flags count

fields.name: total_deliveries
docs: Total deliveries submitted (includes re-deliveries during disputes)

fields.name: corrections_received
docs: Corrections received from requester feedback (quality proxy)

fields.name: active_contracts
docs: Number of currently active contracts (for exposure limit enforcement)

fields.name: last_task_completed_at
docs: Timestamp of last completed task (for TrustScore decay calculation)

fields.name: sponsor_bonus
docs: Sponsor bonus points from established agents

fields.name: banned
docs: Whether identity is permanently banned (fraud)

fields.name: is_hibernating
docs: Hibernation state: 0 = active, 1 = hibernating (Whitepaper §8.6)

fields.name: hibernation_started_at
docs: Timestamp when hibernation started (0 if not hibernating)

fields.name: hibernation_ends_at
docs: Timestamp when hibernation ends (0 if not hibernating)

fields.name: tasks_since_last_hibernation
docs: Tasks completed since last hibernation ended (cooldown = 5 tasks, Whitepaper §8.6)

fields.name: dispute_friction_total
docs: Accumulated dispute friction penalty in centibps (50 = 0.5 pts per round).
Whitepaper §8.1: dispute_friction_total added to S_penalty.
Each Level 2 private round costs 0.5 pts to BOTH parties (max 2.5 per dispute).

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed for PDA derivation

types.name: Bid
docs: Bid on a public contract (Whitepaper §6.5: Public Contract Bidding)
Seeds: [b"bid", contract_key, bidder_key]

fields.name: bid_id
docs: Sequential bid ID (per contract, monotonically increasing)

fields.name: task_id
docs: Contract (task) this bid is for

fields.name: bidder
docs: Bidder agent identity PDA (DID reference)

fields.name: proposed_price
docs: Proposed price in SWORN/SOL lamports (must be <= escrow_amount)

fields.name: proposed_deadline
docs: Proposed deadline in hours

fields.name: bidder_ts
docs: Bidder TrustScore snapshotted at bid time

fields.name: stake_offered
docs: Stake offered by bidder (>= required stake for their TrustScore)

fields.name: message_hash
docs: SHA-256 hash of bid message/proposal

fields.name: timestamp
docs: Timestamp of bid submission

fields.name: bid_score
docs: Computed bid_score (scaled by 10000 for precision, Whitepaper §6.5)

fields.name: active
docs: Whether bid is active (false = withdrawn)

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed

types.name: Contract
docs: Contract between two agents (Whitepaper Section 3: Dynamic Staking)
stake_required = contract_value * factor_stake(TrustScore)
factor_stake: TrustScore 0 => 100%, TrustScore 100 => 5%

fields.name: id
docs: Unique contract ID

fields.name: requester
docs: The agent requesting work

fields.name: provider
docs: The agent performing work

fields.name: value
docs: Contract value in SWORN lamports

fields.name: provider_stake
docs: Stake locked by provider

fields.name: requester_stake
docs: Stake locked by requester (for dispute anti-spam)

fields.name: status
docs: Contract status

fields.name: created_at
docs: Creation timestamp

fields.name: resolved_at
docs: Completion/resolution timestamp

fields.name: poe_hash
docs: Proof of Execution hash (SHA-256 of deliverable)

fields.name: poe_arweave_tx
docs: Arweave TX ID for full PoE data (43 bytes base64url)

fields.name: dispute_level
docs: Dispute level if in dispute (0 = no dispute)

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed

fields.name: proposal_expires_at
docs: Unix timestamp when proposal expires (0 = no expiry / legacy contract)

fields.name: provider_stake_required
docs: Provider stake required (calculated at proposal time, locked for accept)

fields.name: currency
docs: Currency denomination: SWORN (SPL token) or SOL (native lamports)
Whitepaper Section 11.8b: contracts can be denominated in SOL or SWORN

fields.name: escrow_factor_bps
docs: Escrow factor in basis points (Whitepaper §7.7: reduced escrow for experienced requesters)
10000 = 100% (full escrow — new requester, TS=0), 3000 = 30% (TS=100 minimum floor)

fields.name: spec_hash
docs: SHA-256 hash of input specification (Whitepaper §6.1: spec_hash)
Set at contract creation. Used for dispute evidence and PoE verification.

fields.name: corrections_used
docs: Number of corrections used in the pre-dispute correction cycle (Whitepaper §6.2)
Range: 0..max_corrections_contract. When limit reached, auto-escalates to dispute.

fields.name: max_corrections_contract
docs: Per-contract max corrections (Whitepaper §6.1: sla.max_corrections, default 3)
Copied from protocol_config.max_corrections at creation, but can be overridden.

fields.name: deadline_validation_contract
docs: Per-contract validation deadline in seconds (Whitepaper §6.1: sla.deadline_validation)
Copied from protocol_config.deadline_validation at creation. Default 72h = 259200.

fields.name: visibility
docs: Contract visibility (Whitepaper §6.4: private or public)
0 = Private (default), 1 = Public (enables bidding mechanism §6.5)

types.name: Dispute
docs: Dispute account (Whitepaper Section 9: Dispute Resolution)
4 levels: Direct Correction -> Private Rounds -> Public Jury -> Appeal

fields.name: contract
docs: Associated contract

fields.name: initiator
docs: Who initiated the dispute

fields.name: level
docs: Current dispute level

fields.name: status
docs: Dispute status

fields.name: evidence_hash
docs: Evidence hash from initiator

fields.name: response_hash
docs: Response hash from respondent

fields.name: votes_provider
docs: Jury votes for provider (Public Jury / Appeal only)

fields.name: votes_requester
docs: Jury votes for requester

fields.name: jury_size
docs: Total jury members assigned

fields.name: deadline
docs: Escalation deadline (unix timestamp)

fields.name: created_at
docs: Created at

fields.name: resolved_at
docs: Resolved at

fields.name: bump
docs: Bump seed

fields.name: corrections_count
docs: Number of corrections attempted (max 3 before auto-escalate to L2)

fields.name: private_rounds_count
docs: Number of Level 2 private negotiation rounds (max 5, Whitepaper §9.3).
Used to compute dispute friction: 0.5 pts * rounds to each party.

fields.name: appeal_stake
docs: Appeal stake deposited by escalating party (Level 4 only).
On escalation to Appeal: escalating party deposits 50% of contract value.
Losing party forfeits their appeal_stake (60% insurance, 25% winner, 15% burn).
Whitepaper Section 9.5: double-or-nothing with larger jury.

fields.name: arbitration_fee
docs: Arbitration fee per party (2% of contract value, Whitepaper §9.4).
Both parties deposit this when escalating to Level 3 (PublicJury).
Winner recovers theirs; loser's fee is distributed to jury validators.
Stored as the per-party amount (i.e., 2% of contract value).
